ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..
   D. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

8. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
